name: Datasette
category: data publishing tool (web UI/API over SQLite)
param_style: Python sqlite3 :name parameters (:p0.., :search, :q, permission rule params); FK label lookups and some catalog reads use positional ? (normalised to ?N); SQL text generated per request
schema_source: user tables copied from datasette/fixtures.py (facet_cities, facetable, searchable + FTS5, tags, searchable_tags); internal catalog from INTERNAL_DB_SCHEMA_SQL in datasette/utils/internal_db.py
data_scale: scale 1: 300 facet_cities, 100k facetable, 40k searchable (FTS5 external content), 80k searchable_tags; internal catalog with 3 databases, 261 tables, 21 views, 1.7k columns, 60 stored queries
visibility_note: 11.5k stars; the standard tool for publishing SQLite databases on the web, and every page view is generated SQL
interest_note: Facet machinery (GROUP BY over derived tables, json_each array facets with DISTINCT join-back, date() facets, sampled suggestion probes), FTS5 rowid-IN search, keyset pagination with OR-expanded tie-breaks, and the permission resolver: CTEs with UNION ALL rules, COLLATE NOCASE, MAX(CASE)/json_group_array aggregates and a CASE cascade.
